repairs.correction: 아래 ruleChecks에 기록된 최종 조건·대상·단위로 최소 수정; before 원본과 candidate 비교 가능
repairs.quote: Rammus hops into the air and slams down in an area, dealing (150/250/350 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 30/40/50% for 1.5 seconds. If used during Powerball, enemies in the center take an additional (80/120/160/200/240 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and are Knocked Up for 0.75 seconds. Rammus then creates 3 aftershocks in the area over 3.5 seconds, repeating the Slow. The range of this Ability is increased by Rammus's Move Speed. This Ability deals 200% damage to turrets.

proposalDecisions.reason: 거리등식 대신 중앙에있는적이라는 텍스트 activation 범위조건으로 보존.
R기본과추가피해 모두 magic이고 포탑문장은 이스킬피해200%배율이다. 피해종류를새로단정한독립피해가 아닌 기존피해modifier로 보존했다.
